---
title: "Tidyverse"
format:
  revealjs:
    slide-number: false
    center: true
    transition: fade
    background-transition: fade
    width: 1400
    height: 800
---

<style>

.reveal {
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}

.reveal h2 {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 1.4em;
  margin-bottom: 45px;
  color: #333;
}

/* Data tables */

.data-box {
  background: #e8f1fa;
  border: 4px solid #4e79a7;
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 18px 24px;
}

.result-box {
  background: #e5f3e5;
  border-color: #59a14f;
}

.second-box {
  background: #fff0df;
  border-color: #f28e2b;
}

.reveal table {
  font-size: 0.72em;
  margin: auto;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.reveal table th {
  font-weight: bold;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #555;
}

.reveal table td,
.reveal table th {
  padding: 0.32em 0.65em;
}

/* Function call */

.operation {
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: left;
}

.function-box {
  background: #f3dfeb;
  border: 4px solid #b07aa1;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 18px;
  font-size: 0.68em;
  width: 100%;
}

.function-box pre {
  margin: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  background: transparent;
}

.function-box code {
  background: transparent;
}

.arrow {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 2em;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

/* LEFT JOIN */

.join-vertical {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.join-before {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  width: 62%;
}

.join-before .data-box {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 6px 10px;
}

.join-before table {
  font-size: 0.55em;
}

.join-before table td,
.join-before table th {
  padding: 0.18em 0.4em;
}

.plus {
  font-size: 1.2em;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.join-code {
  width: 38%;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 0.55em;
}

.join-result {
  width: 38%;
  padding: 6px 10px;
}

.join-result table {
  font-size: 0.55em;
}

.join-result table td,
.join-result table th {
  padding: 0.18em 0.4em;
}

.join-vertical .arrow {
  font-size: 1.3em;
  margin: -4px 0;
}

</style>


## `filter()`

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="38%"}

<div class="data-box">

| patient | age | group |
|:-------:|:---:|:-----:|
| A | 23 | Control |
| B | 41 | Treatment |
| C | 35 | Control |
| D | 52 | Treatment |
| E | 29 | Control |

</div>

:::

::: {.column width="24%"}

<div class="operation">

<div class="function-box">

```r
data %>%
  filter(
    group == "Treatment"
  )
```

</div>

<div class="arrow">→</div>

</div>

:::

::: {.column width="38%"}

<div class="data-box result-box">

| patient | age | group |
|:-------:|:---:|:-----:|
| B | 41 | Treatment |
| D | 52 | Treatment |

</div>

:::

:::


## `pivot_longer()`

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="35%"}

<div class="data-box">

| patient | IgG | IgM | IgA |
|:-------:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| A | 12 | 4 | 8 |
| B | 18 | 7 | 10 |
| C | 15 | 5 | 9 |

</div>

:::

::: {.column width="30%"}

<div class="operation">

<div class="function-box">

```r
data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(IgG, IgM, IgA),
    names_to = "antibody",
    values_to = "value"
  )
```

</div>

<div class="arrow">→</div>

</div>

:::

::: {.column width="35%"}

<div class="data-box result-box">

| patient | antibody | value |
|:-------:|:--------:|:-----:|
| A | IgG | 12 |
| A | IgM | 4 |
| A | IgA | 8 |
| B | IgG | 18 |
| B | IgM | 7 |
| B | IgA | 10 |
| C | IgG | 15 |
| C | IgM | 5 |
| C | IgA | 9 |

</div>

:::

:::


## `pivot_wider()`

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="35%"}

<div class="data-box">

| patient | antibody | value |
|:-------:|:--------:|:-----:|
| A | IgG | 12 |
| A | IgM | 4 |
| A | IgA | 8 |
| B | IgG | 18 |
| B | IgM | 7 |
| B | IgA | 10 |
| C | IgG | 15 |
| C | IgM | 5 |
| C | IgA | 9 |

</div>

:::

::: {.column width="30%"}

<div class="operation">

<div class="function-box">

```r
data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "antibody",
    values_from = "value"
  )
```

</div>

<div class="arrow">→</div>

</div>

:::

::: {.column width="35%"}

<div class="data-box result-box">

| patient | IgG | IgM | IgA |
|:-------:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| A | 12 | 4 | 8 |
| B | 18 | 7 | 10 |
| C | 15 | 5 | 9 |

</div>

:::

:::

<style>

/* LEFT JOIN — code left, data flow right */

.join-layout-horizontal {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 34% 66%;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 35px;
  width: 92%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Code on left */

.join-code-left {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 20px 22px;
  font-size: 0.78em;
}

.join-code-left pre {
  margin: 0;
}

.join-code-left code {
  font-size: 1em;
  line-height: 1.4;
}


/* Diagram on right */

.join-flow {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.join-inputs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 28px;
  width: 100%;
}

.join-inputs .data-box {
  padding: 10px 14px;
}

.join-inputs table {
  font-size: 0.62em;
}

.join-inputs table td,
.join-inputs table th {
  padding: 0.22em 0.55em;
}


/* Converging arrows */

.join-arrows {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  width: 72%;
  font-size: 1.8em;
  line-height: 1;
  margin: -2px 0;
}

.join-arrow-left {
  text-align: center;
}

.join-arrow-right {
  text-align: center;
}


/* Result */

.join-result-horizontal {
  width: 68%;
  padding: 10px 16px;
}

.join-result-horizontal table {
  font-size: 0.64em;
}

.join-result-horizontal table td,
.join-result-horizontal table th {
  padding: 0.22em 0.55em;
}

</style>


## `left_join()`

<div class="join-layout-horizontal">


<!-- CODE ON LEFT -->

<div class="function-box join-code-left">

```r
patients %>%
  left_join(
    results,
    by = "patient"
  )
```

</div>


<!-- DATA FLOW ON RIGHT -->

<div class="join-flow">

<div class="join-inputs">

<div class="data-box">

| patient | age |
|:-------:|:---:|
| A | 23 |
| B | 41 |
| C | 35 |
| D | 52 |

</div>


<div class="data-box second-box">

| patient | result |
|:-------:|:------:|
| A | Positive |
| B | Negative |
| D | Positive |
| E | Negative |

</div>

</div>


<div class="join-arrows">

<div class="join-arrow-left">↘</div>

<div class="join-arrow-right">↙</div>

</div>


<div class="data-box result-box join-result-horizontal">

| patient | age | result |
|:-------:|:---:|:------:|
| A | 23 | Positive |
| B | 41 | Negative |
| C | 35 | NA |
| D | 52 | Positive |

</div>

</div>

</div>
